boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Canisius University
boards.description: Ten Buffalo food destinations with directly published current late hours; confirm hours before leaving campus because schedules can change.

cards.title: Jim's SteakOut on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 3094 Main St., Buffalo
cards.notes: Use the Main Street location when you need a clearly published late option. Check the posted day-specific closing time before starting from campus.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street counter-service stop with hours extending to 2 or 4 a.m., depending on day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim's SteakOut lists its Main Street Buffalo location at 3094 Main St. and posts closing at 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Sunday–Wednesday 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; Thursday 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–4 a.m. Walk-in orders are accepted until posted closing.

cards.title: Jim's SteakOut on Delaware
cards.subtitle: 2611 Delaware Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Keep this Delaware Avenue location as a late food backup. Use the restaurant's location page to check the closing time before you go.
cards.short_summary: A Buffalo Jim's SteakOut location with late listed service windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim's SteakOut's ordering page identifies a Delaware Avenue location at 2611 Delaware Ave., Buffalo, with ordering shown through 3:45 a.m. at the time indexed.
cards.source_title: Jim's SteakOut Locations and Ordering Hours
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page listed Delaware at 2611 Delaware Ave. and showed closing at 3:45 a.m.; verify live ordering availability before departure.

cards.title: Jim's SteakOut on Elmwood
cards.subtitle: 938 Elmwood Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Choose the Elmwood location for a late food run and use the posted schedule to time it. Ordering services can stop before the walk-in closing time.
cards.short_summary: The original Elmwood Jim's SteakOut posts service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim's SteakOut lists the original Elmwood Village location at 938 Elmwood Ave.; its posted hours run until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 10:30 a.m.–4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. The business says online ordering may end before posted closing.

cards.title: Mighty Taco at Delaware and Hertel
cards.subtitle: 2363 Delaware Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru schedule for a late pickup plan. The dining room closes earlier, so check which service option remains available before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Delaware Avenue taco stop whose official listing keeps the drive-thru open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Mighty Taco lists Delaware @ Hertel at 2363 Delaware Ave., Buffalo, with a drive-thru open until midnight every day and earlier dining-room closing.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours: until 12 a.m. daily. Published dining-room hours: until 11 p.m.; verify service status before travel.

cards.title: Teton Kitchen Elmwood
cards.subtitle: 153 Elmwood Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday visit if you need the latest listed window. Review the restaurant's hours page before heading out from campus.
cards.short_summary: An Elmwood Village Thai and Japanese restaurant with midnight Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Teton Kitchen lists its Elmwood restaurant at 153 Elmwood Ave. and posts Friday and Saturday hours through midnight.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Tuesday until 11 p.m.; Wednesday–Thursday until 11 p.m.; Friday–Saturday until 12 a.m.; Sunday until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Breezy Burrito Bar
cards.subtitle: 1000 Elmwood Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Use the published Friday or Saturday schedule for a midnight plan. Check the business site for any same-day changes before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Burrito Bar on Elmwood with posted Friday and Saturday hours past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Breezy Burrito Bar lists its Buffalo address as 1000 Elmwood Ave. and posts Friday and Saturday hours of 12 a.m. or later.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Tuesday–Thursday until 10 p.m.; Friday 5 p.m.–12 a.m.+; Saturday 12 p.m.–12 a.m.+; Sunday until 8 p.m.

cards.title: Jack Rabbit Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1010 Elmwood Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: For a weekend late menu, confirm the current Friday or Saturday food service before leaving. The site separately identifies late-night food timing.
cards.short_summary: An Elmwood restaurant that explicitly posts late-night food through 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack Rabbit Restaurant lists 1010 Elmwood Ave. and states that late-night food is available until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack Rabbit Restaurant — Hours and Location
cards.access_notes: Published Friday and Saturday hours run until 2 a.m., with the site specifically stating late-night food until 2 a.m. Confirm service before travel.

cards.title: Casa Azul
cards.subtitle: 191 Allen St., Buffalo
cards.notes: Use this option for its posted weekend kitchen window. Check the restaurant's own page before departing, especially because weekday and weekend schedules differ.
cards.short_summary: An Allen Street restaurant with kitchen hours listed through 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Azul lists 191 Allen St., Buffalo, and posts kitchen hours until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published kitchen hours: Monday–Thursday until 11 p.m.; Friday–Saturday until 2 a.m.; Sunday closed. Verify current service before departure.

cards.title: Gramma Mora's
cards.subtitle: 1465 Hertel Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Make a Friday or Saturday plan when you want the latest listed dinner service. Consult the restaurant's hours page before you leave campus.
cards.short_summary: A Hertel Avenue Mexican restaurant with late-week dinner service listed until 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Gramma Mora's lists its address at 1465 Hertel Ave. and posts Friday and Saturday restaurant hours through 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours: Tuesday–Thursday until 9:30 p.m.; Friday until 10:30 p.m.; Saturday until 10:30 p.m. The restaurant is closed Monday and Sunday.

cards.title: Avenue on Hertel
cards.subtitle: 1116 Hertel Ave., Buffalo
cards.notes: Use the all-week posted schedule for an evening meal plan. Check directly with the restaurant before travel if you are arriving close to closing.
cards.short_summary: A Hertel Avenue restaurant listing 10 p.m. closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Avenue on Hertel lists its address as 1116 Hertel Ave., Buffalo, and posts hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Sunday. Confirm current service before travel, particularly near closing.
